purpose: Measure whether the preregistered broad galaxy and cluster tests can actually be executed, while keeping source availability, spent evidence, inferred halo products, and prospective raw validation targets in distinct scientific roles.

readiness_definitions.source_universe_ready: Enough outcome-blind source-side candidates exist to satisfy the future sample size and state-balance minima.
readiness_definitions.prospective_sample_admitted: Every selected object has passed source completeness and target-likelihood metadata gates, with target values still sealed.
readiness_definitions.execution_ready: A frozen action, constants, solver and nuisance policy exist and all admitted raw target payloads are content-addressed for one-time opening.
readiness_definitions.spent_development_only: The data may reject or diagnose a mechanism but cannot provide a new blind validation claim.
readiness_definitions.model_derived_discovery_only: A halo or lens reconstruction may generate hypotheses or serve as a disclosed comparator but cannot be validation truth.
